rule: Both arms measured against SPY, not just each other. Arm B figures MUST be deposit-adjusted using rh_deposits.json before any comparison.
design_principle: Match the strategy to the platform's execution reliability. Stops need minutes; buy-and-hold tolerates hours. So the hybrid lives where execution is a solved problem.

arm_B.name: Robinhood — INDEX ETFs (buy and hold)

arm_B.execution: Robinhood native recurring investments — no laptop, no bridge
arm_B.note: Laptop bot RETIRED. Deposits ~$10/wk continue; keep logging them in rh_deposits.json.
